summary: The diff implements audio playback fixes for the Mood Music feature by adding comprehensive error handling, logging, and state management to the useAudioPlayer hook, and updating the catalog to use externally hosted SoundHelix demo MP3 URLs. However, this violates the constraint requiring local bundled audio files and does not fully address REQ-16's acceptance criteria for local file verification.

missing_requirements.requirement: Verify that all audio file URLs in the mood music catalog point to valid, accessible audio files in the frontend/public directory
missing_requirements.reason: The catalog.ts was updated to use external URLs (https://www.soundhelix.com/examples/mp3/) instead of local files in frontend/public/assets/audio/. The constraint explicitly states 'Use only bundled local audio files; do not introduce external streaming services or APIs', which is violated.

hallucinated_features.description: Using external streaming URLs from soundhelix.com for audio tracks
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest constraint explicitly prohibits external streaming services or APIs and requires 'Use only bundled local audio files'. The catalog now references external URLs (https://www.soundhelix.com/examples/mp3/SoundHelix-Song-*.mp3) rather than local files in the public directory.
